simple.meaning: בְּתוּלִים (bᵉthûwlîym) is a Hebrew word meaning “(collectively and abstractly) virginity ; by implication and concretely, the tokens of it.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בְּתוּלִים (H1331) appears 10 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Leviticus 21:13, with occurrences in Leviticus, Deuteronomy, Judges, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בְּתוּלִים (H1331) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בְּתוּלִים (H1331) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בְּתוּלִים (bᵉthûwlîym) / H1331 is traced through Leviticus 21:13, Deuteronomy 22:14, Deuteronomy 22:15, Deuteronomy 22:17 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: (collectively and abstractly) virginity ; by implication and concretely, the tokens of it
definitions.full: H1331. bethulim בְּתוּלִים noun feminine virginity , plural absolute intensive Deut 22:14 , 17 , 20 ; construct בְּתוּלֵי 22:15 , 17 , all concrete, tokens of virginity ; abstract, suffix בְּתוּלַי Judg 11:37 ; בְּתוּלֶיהָ Lev 21:13 ; Judg 11:38 ; Ezek 23:8 ; בְּתוּלֵיהֶן 23:3 .
